Mobile · 2025

Wellty

Identity-Based Wellness App

Role
Product Designer & iOS Builder
Stack
SwiftUI / iOS / Wellness UX / Gamification / Local Persistence

Wellty is a wellness app that reframes self-care around identity instead of metrics. Rather than starting with dashboards, the experience asks who the user wants to be that day and turns that intention into short, actionable habits.

The problem

Most wellness apps open on a dashboard full of metrics. That is a lot of numbers to face before doing anything.

Start with who you want to be

Wellty opens with one question: who do you want to be today? That intention turns into short, concrete habits.

Two-minute actions

Each habit is a micro-action of about two minutes. Finishing one gives XP and moves your progress across the seven dimensions of wellness.

A loop that feels light

The goal was a behavior loop that feels light but still means something: choose an identity, act for two minutes, see the feedback.

How I built it

I designed the experience and built it in SwiftUI with local persistence.

Outcome

Wellty won 1st place at the iOS Lab Universidad Panamericana x Windsurf hackathon.
